description: Search for trading cards and sealed products on Cardpeer. Returns one result per product with the cheapest active listing price AND last known market/Cardpeer price. All prices are in euro cents (500 = €5.00).

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

q.description: Free-text search — card name, set, series, number

ships_from.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of seller (e.g. "NL")

sort.description: Sort order: price_asc/price_desc = cheapest listing price, last_price_desc = last known historical price descending

type.description: Product type. Use "card" for single cards.

name: search_cards
